NOTE
**Still not ready**

|     |         |
| --- | ------- |
| ⚠️  | Don't close the issue: the description now says "Part of #16189", but there is no new push, so the commit message is unchanged |
| ❌  | Explain how the fixture was captured: the description says it was built from Atlassian's API docs, not captured from a real Jira instance, which the fixture guidelines don't allow |
| ✅  | Add a screenshot of the new notification to the description |
| ℹ️  | A similar Jira PR (#39998) was told that constructed fixtures are not accepted |

###### Next step

Keep "not ready" and ask the author to replace the constructed fixture with a payload captured from a real Jira instance, and to push the commit message fix.

###### Reply

```quote
Thanks for the updates, the screenshot and the "Part of #16189" description look good. The fixture still needs to be a payload captured from a real Jira instance (see the [fixture guidelines](https://zulip.readthedocs.io/en/latest/webhooks/incoming-webhooks-walkthrough.html#fixture-guidelines)), not one built from the API docs. Please also push the commit message change, since the commit itself hasn't changed yet.
```
